title: Turn Every Agent Correction into a System Improvement
service: Promote: correction evidence to effective durable controls
runtime: Python 3.10+, standard library, pytest; no model or network

parts.lesson_anchor: Promote to the Earliest Effective Layer; Ratchet Record; code choose_target/normalize_cause/ratchet
planted_bugs: product disagreement routed to instruction; ratchet result exposes choose_target two calls below
one-off minor correction earns permanent control
later independent correction loses earlier recurrence increment
growing grouped prefix sorted after every observation
parts.overfix_guard: original cause/symptom preserved; eligibility after grouping; severe first occurrence

parts.lesson_anchor: The Ratchet Record: symptom, root cause, consequence, recurrence, control, verification, owner and review date
parts.exactness: Control and Record values, original multiline Unicode text, integer count, empty or nonempty owner, ISO or free-form review-date text survive reopen exactly
traps: snapshot replacement must not add already accumulated recurrence
restore full correction evidence and dataclass types
filter stored target rather than infer it

parts.lesson_anchor: Separate Cause from Symptom; Promote to Earliest Effective Layer
parts.algorithm: group explicit canonical causes; qualify verified cause-covering non-symptom proposals; choose earliest effective layer with human-only product decisions
traps: same symptom does not merge different causes
verified and covers are eligibility before layer choice
a rule repeating symptoms is not a cause control
human judgment cannot be displaced by an automatic candidate

parts.lesson_anchor: Ratchet Record recurrence/consequence; Exercise 3 severe first occurrence
parts.wire_format: SSE event: promoted and one JSON data line, supplied _line
traps: continue other causes after a promotion
yield before pulling future observations; cancellation
clarifying_questions: promotion is permanent within the view

parts.lesson_anchor: Find root cause -> Earliest owner diagram; Separate Cause from Symptom
traps: shared node evaluated at every path depth
group by cause and owner while preserving symptoms

deviations: Original normalize_cause already lowercases; internal whitespace is a deliberately planted finite identity defect, not a claim that original code misses uppercase.

Finite consequence enum, recurrence increments, supplied covers/verified, finite layer ordering and why-DAG effective owners are deterministic exercise annotations. They do not infer real causality or approval.
SQLite stores complete snapshots, not occurrence increments. Ownership policy is upstream; this avoids repeating lesson45 nonblank-owner debugging.

Window accumulation and SSE serialization are supplied correct helpers. Candidate work is severe-first promotion, continuing other causes, immediate emission and cancellation rather than repeating a second multi-source count-merging algorithm.
The planned 50k repeated sorting is reduced to4500 observations so the slow layer remains about2seconds. All source text and counts stay in full ratchet records.
